caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with two stylized green leafy branches curving upward and inward from the bottom left and right, forming a partial wreath. At the top of each branch, there is a flower or fruit-like form in red, each adorned with small white spots and dark spots, along with green leaves. The two red forms are similar and positioned to face each other, each with three smaller red buds extending from their tops. At the base center between the two branches, there is a red and blue flower with a checked blue and pink center, surrounded by petals outlined in red with white dots and blue edges. In the white space at the center of the composition, between the green leafy branches, the word "Mother." is written in a cursive, black script. The entire composition is set within a single, thin rectangular border with a gold line on the inside. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or cream color.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
